title: fix(poweredBy): minify slightly and make into correct URL
body:
**Summary**

FireFox is very picky about data URIs and as soon as it's containing `#`, it's interpreting it as a link instead of a data URI. You can escape those `#` with `%23`

check this in FF: https://deploy-preview-2615--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=SearchBox.default

**Result**

fixes #2613
